backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing video project CRUD operations with access control, storing VideoProject records (title, concept, length, style, audience, status, thumbnail) in a Map with user authentication checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (landing page, project creation, script editor, voiceover, sound effects, music library, generation progress, video player) to their corresponding frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON object containing one-line summaries of all frontend files including pages, components, hooks, and configuration files for the cinematic AI video generation platform.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system defining light and dark theme variables for background, foreground, card, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, border, and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script loading main.tsx, titled 'Cinematic AI Studio'.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component configuring TanStack Router with 9 routes (landing, create, projects, script, voiceover, sound-effects, music, status, video) wrapped in ThemeProvider and Layout with Toaster.
frontend/src/components/GenerationProgre: Component displaying video generation progress with overall progress bar, five stage indicators (script, visuals, voiceover, sound, mixing) showing completion status, and estimated time remaining.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Layout wrapper with header containing logo, navigation (Projects, New Project for authenticated users), login/logout button, and footer with branding and Caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/MusicLibrary.tsx: React component for browsing and selecting background music tracks with filters for mood, genre, and tempo. Includes preview playback and navigation to the next step (status page).
frontend/src/components/ProjectCard.tsx: Displays a video project as a clickable card with thumbnail, title, status badge, duration, and creation date. Routes to different pages based on project status (draft/generating/completed).
frontend/src/components/ScriptEditor.tsx: Allows users to generate or edit video scripts with customizable parameters (tone, pacing, structure). Includes AI-powered script generation simulation and navigation to voiceover configuration.
frontend/src/components/SoundEffectsLibr: Provides a searchable library of sound effects with category filters, multi-select functionality, and preview playback. Users can select multiple effects before proceeding to music selection.
frontend/src/components/VideoPlayer.tsx: Displays the completed video with playback controls, project details (duration, creation date, resolution), and actions for downloading and sharing the video.
Configures voiceover settings including voice gender, accent, and tone with preview and generation functionality. Navigates to sound effects library after voiceover generation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that manages the backend actor instance using React Query, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity state and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for managing user login/logout state, including identity persistence, delegation validation, and AuthClient configuration with idle handling options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating video projects, including listing all projects, fetching individual projects with polling for generating status, and creating/updating projects.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark themes, defining a cinematic color palette (teal, gold, charcoal) and typography using Playfair Display for headings.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClientProvider for React Query and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication context.
frontend/src/pages/CreateProjectPage.tsx: Page component for creating new video projects with a form for title, concept, duration (30s-15min), style preferences, and target audience, requiring authentication to access.
Page component that displays video generation progress with polling, automatically redirecting to the video page when generation completes, requiring authentication to view.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Marketing landing page showcasing the AI video generation platform's features (script writing, voiceover, sound effects, music, Sora video generation) with hero section and call-to-action buttons.
frontend/src/pages/MusicSelectionPage.ts: Page component that displays the MusicLibrary component for a specific project, with authentication checks and loading/error states for unauthenticated users or missing projects.
frontend/src/pages/ProjectsPage.tsx: Page component that displays a filterable list of user projects with tabs for all/draft/generating/completed statuses, requiring authentication and showing empty states when no projects exist.
frontend/src/pages/ScriptEditorPage.tsx: Page component that renders the ScriptEditor component for a specific project, with authentication guards and error handling for missing projects.
frontend/src/pages/SoundEffectsPage.tsx: Page component that displays the SoundEffectsLibrary component for a specific project, with authentication checks and loading/error states similar to MusicSelectionPage.
frontend/src/pages/VideoPlayerPage.tsx: Page component that renders the VideoPlayer component for completed projects, with authentication checks and additional validation that the project status is 'completed' before displaying the video.
frontend/src/pages/VoiceoverPage.tsx: Page component that displays the VoiceoverConfig component for a specific project, with authentication guards and error handling for missing projects.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing functions to extract, store, and manage URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support and parameter cleanup capabilities.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining custom color palette using OKLCH color space, typography settings with Inter and Playfair Display fonts, container queries, animations, and extended theme tokens for a design system with sidebar, chart, and custom brand colors (teal, gold, charcoal).
project_state.json: Project state file documenting an AI-powered long-form video generation platform with Sora integration, supporting 15-minute videos with features including AI script writing, voiceover, sound effects, music integration, and a multi-modal pipeline from script to final video output.
